metadata.title: Soul Moods Album Cover Layout
useCases: Event posters for jazz or soul music

retrievalProfile.description: A classic soul music layout featuring a low-key, intimate portrait paired with large, high-contrast serif display type and a structured tracklist.
triggerTerms: low-key portrait with large serif text

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a close-up, dimly lit portrait of a woman looking downward, occupying the left half, while the right half uses large, bold serif typography and a structured list of text elements against a dark, textured background.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast relationship between cream-colored text and dark background
Asymmetrical balance between the subject on the left and text blocks on the right
Visual hierarchy established through varying font sizes and weights
coreInvariants: Low-key, moody lighting on the subject
Large, italicized or bold serif display type
Horizontal bar element for volume or subtitle information

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the left third, cropped from the shoulders up, looking down and inward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large display word at the top right acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top text, move down the right-side tracklist, and finally rest on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows and dark background provide significant negative space for text legibility.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and dark blue-grey background
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream or off-white for primary display text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold or tan for the horizontal subtitle bar
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the typography.

letterConstructionRules: Thick vertical strokes with thin horizontal hairlines
Italicized lowercase for secondary display words
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for titles paired with a lighter weight of the same family or a clean transitional serif for tracklists.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rectangular bar containing spaced-out text
Vignetted edges to focus on the subject

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast vertical stress of the display type.
Appropriate for the secondary 'moods' style text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square, low-key portrait of a woman looking down in profile, lit from the side with soft shadows. The background should be dark charcoal with a slight grainy texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large bold serif text in cream at the top right. Below it, add an italicized serif word. Place a horizontal tan bar with widely spaced blue serif text below that. Arrange a centered list of artist names and song titles in the bottom right quadrant.

verificationChecks: Is the subject looking downward and to the left?
Is the primary display text high-contrast serif?
Is there a horizontal bar element for volume/metadata?
Is the color palette restricted to muted, dark tones?

adjustableVariables: Color of the horizontal accent bar
mustRedesign: Transcribing specific artist names or song titles
Using the exact likeness of the person in the photo
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the dark background
Verify the 'volume' bar is horizontally centered relative to the right column
Check that the subject's face is not obscured by the main text blocks
Confirm the use of serif fonts throughout
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key intimate portrait [Subject] with high-contrast serif typography [Title] and a structured tracklist [Metadata] to create a classic soul aesthetic.
